title: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi transferred to a Tehran hospital, her foundation says
summary: Nobel Peace laureate and activist Narges Mohammadi has been transferred to a Tehran hospital more than a week after collapsing in prison, her foundation said Sunday.
contentText:
Nobel Peace laureate and activist Narges Mohammadi has been transferred to a Tehran hospital more than a week after collapsing in prison, her foundation said Sunday.

(Image credit: Narges Foundation Archive)
